ModMetaData.name: Latios' Arsenal
ModMetaData.author: UNSCLatios
ModMetaData.description:
[h1][b]Latios' Arsenal (拉帝欧斯的军械库)[/b][/h1]
Two content packs for colonies that fight with salvaged mechanoid hardware: five launchers and a belt-mounted biofoam injector. Packs are switched on individually in the mod settings, and a disabled pack is stripped before the game reads its content, so it never loads.
[b]Features[/b] [list] [*] The launchers come in the compact BL bullpup pattern and the heavier HL shoulder-fired pattern, feeding the mechanoid 66mm thermal bolt, 80x256mm fuel cell and 164x284mm demolition shell, so ammunition stripped from a battlefield fits them directly. [*] The bullpup guns are hand-loaded one round at a time, while the shoulder-fired guns swap the whole rotary magazine in one slower reload. [*] Every launcher can switch to a high-arc shot that clears walls and cover - slower, longer to aim and cycle, and landing inside a circle around the target cell, with a heavier penalty on the bullpup pattern - and its effective range is capped at what the shell can really reach, so a range boost cannot produce shots that fall short. [*] The bullpup pattern unlocks with basic mechtech and fabrication and the heavy pattern with high mechtech and fabrication, both built at the fabrication bench from steel, components and mechanoid slag. [*] The biofoam injector spends one of four charges to seal the worst bleeding wound at a fixed 75% dressing quality, refills two charges per medicine through a short job, and can be left to refill itself while the wearer is idle. [/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b] Built for RimWorld 1.7, it requires Harmony, Combat Extended and Biotech, and should load after Combat Extended.
[b]Credits[/b] The launcher line, in design and in the look of the guns, is inspired by Local's CE Mechscav guns, with no assets reused, copied or stitched and no AI image-to-image work involved; all art was drawn for this mod, every feature was tested in an actual colony, and development used DS v4.1 flash with DSH on a pipeline based on RimDevTools (https://github.com/1264600905/RimDevTools).
------
[h1][b]Latios' Arsenal (拉帝欧斯的军械库)[/b][/h1]
拉帝欧斯的军械库包含两个内容包：用机械族废料拼装的五把发射器，以及一套腰带式生物泡沫注射器。内容包在模组设置里单独开关，关掉的内容包在游戏读取内容之前就被摘掉，不会进入运行中的游戏。
[b]内容[/b] [list] [*] 发射器分紧凑的无托 BL 系列与更重的肩扛 HL 系列，直接使用机械族自用的 66mm 热能弹、80x256mm 燃料弹与 164x284mm 爆破弹，战场上捡到的弹药可以直接装填。 [*] 无托型号手动逐发压弹，肩扛型号直接更换整个转轮弹舱，单次装填更慢。 [*] 每把武器都能切换到高抛射击：弹道越过墙体与掩体，弹速更慢、瞄准与冷却更长，落点以目标格子为中心圆形散布（无托型号代价更重）；高抛的有效射程还会按弹头实际能打到的距离夹紧，射程加成不会让它变成打不到目标的空放。 [*] 无托型在基础机械科技与精密装配后解锁，重型型需要高级机械科技与精密装配，均在精密装配台用钢铁、零部件与机械族残块制作。 [*] 生物泡沫注射器有 4 次充能，流血速度超过阈值时以固定 75% 的包扎质量封住最严重的出血伤口，1 份医药经一段装填作业恢复 2 次充能，空闲时也可由穿戴者自行装填。 [/list]
[b]兼容性与前置[/b] 面向 RimWorld 1.7，需要 Harmony、Combat Extended 与 Biotech，并应排在 Combat Extended 之后加载。
[b]致谢[/b] 武器线的设计思路与枪械外观风格参考 Local's CE Mechscav guns，未使用其素材拼接或修改，也未做人工智能图像到图像处理；所有美术素材由作者制作，全部功能经作者在真实殖民地充分测试，开发使用 DS v4.1 flash 与 DSH，流程基于 RimDevTools（https://github.com/1264600905/RimDevTools）。
